input_file.description: Path to the dBase III/IV (.dbf) file to display

browse_mode.description: Enable browse mode (no field names, single-line records)

delimiter.description: Field separator used in browse mode (e.g., tab, pipe, colon)

show_deleted.description: Include deleted records and show delete state

preserve_case.description: Keep original field name casing (do not convert to title case)

trim_values.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace from field values

show_info.description: Display technical database metadata (record count, record size, etc.)

encoding.description: Encoding conversion hint for legacy dBase files (e.g., 'ibmpc:latin1' via recode)
